topic.title: Splitting Clean
topic.claim: The friend group that's been together ten years still splits every single bill down to the rupee using an app.
topic.behaviour: Splitwise gets used for a 400 rupee dinner among friends who've known each other since school.
topic.mechanism: Being exactly fair became more important than being generous because everyone's quietly tracking now.
topic.group: long term friend groups who hang out often
topic.why_now: splitting apps have become the default even among the closest friends

score.why: A specific, funny habit (ten-year friend group still splitting bills by app) that fits her 'checks prices on three apps' texture.
